mrlResults.metricDefinition: 2026 SC Revenue / Slimming Centre Revenue only

latestHistoricalSnapshot.notes: Store Sales proxy may include PRHB / EERR / other sales.

guardrails: PRHB and EERR are supplemental and excluded from the main SC KPI.
A Store Sales MTD proxy is used only when dated source evidence exists and confirmed SC is missing for that month.
Confirmed SC and a proxy are never added for the same month.
Historical weekly snapshots are trend evidence only and are never summed into current YTD.
Total SC revenue divided by ad spend is not presented as attributed ROAS.

guardrails: The six completely damaged cartons are excluded once only.
Staff/Shopee overlap is deducted once; cancelled orders and duplicate movement IDs must be excluded.
Payment notification alone is not shipment evidence and does not reduce stock.
7/14/28-pack equivalents are packaging-capacity references, not sealed-SKU inventory, and must not be added together.
Released income is not net profit. True net profit is not calculated until shipping, product and other costs are complete.
